key_results: VPS37A downregulation (via 8p deletion) creates dependency on MAP3K7-NF-κB-CFLAR axis; inhibition triggers CASP8-mediated apoptosis; vulnerability depends on ATG8ylated membranes enabling CASP8 activation upon phagophore closure blockade; selective apoptosis in VPS37A-deficient spheroids despite co-deletion of death receptors TNFRSF10A/B
comments: Reveals a synthetic lethal vulnerability in cancers with recurrent 8p deletions, linking ESCRT function to autophagy-dependent apoptosis priming, though the precise role of ATG8ylated membranes in CASP8 activation warrants mechanistic clarification.
